sv.title: Vi vet i varje fall att vi kommer att få en kass statsminister
sv.summary: En kvinna utan principer som inget sa i valrörelsen? Eller en man utan principer som ingen ville se i valrörelsen? Spänningen stiger.

en.title: We at least know we're going to get a lousy prime minister
en.summary: A woman without principles who said nothing during the election campaign? Or a man without principles whom no one wanted to see during the election campaign? The tension is rising.
